description: `useReducer` inside a provider component, with state and `dispatch` exposed through context. A feature-scoped store.
Separate contexts for state and `dispatch`, so dispatch-only components do not re-render on state changes.
A component like `TasksProvider` that owns the state and renders the providers around `children`.
A Hook like `useTasks()` that reads a context and throws a clear error when no provider exists.
